_comment: Deny rules and hooks live here: both apply regardless of workspace trust, and deny always beats allow. Allow rules live in settings.local.json for the opposite reason. File rules use Edit(...) not Write(...) - Write rules are not evaluated by file permission checks at all, so a Write(...) deny protecting something sensitive does nothing, while Edit(...) covers every file-editing tool.
_comment_scope: This bot is the only one that writes outside its own folder, so its fences are the most specific in the Agency. The sibling trees are denied outright: their isolation is the point of the layout, and a repair bot with write access to all four would quietly undo it. Their bugs get diagnosed and a fix proposed under repairs/proposed/, which Benny applies.
_comment_self: The denies on ./.claude/** and ./scripts/** are aimed at this bot itself. A bot that can edit its own guard hook has no guard hook, and a bot that can edit the health check can make every probe pass.
